name: L-Sit
research: Two parallettes (props_other.parallette, one under each fist, handles running front-to-back along the grip axis, legs stretched to the floor). Hands beside the hips, arms straight and vertical (elev 2, elbow 2; library step 2), neutral grip (knuckles out, axis forward). Body lifted off the floor: root [0, 0.04, 0.47], hips level with the fists ~0.15 m above them. Straight legs held level with the hips (library step 3): ankle = hip + 0.885 m forward, toes pointed 35 deg, heels ~0.47 m above the floor. Slight low-back round (spine05 3, spine04 2). Low front-side camera so the abs show. Facts: research/l_sit.json.
